2946-4871-5670-7452.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5670-7452.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5670-7452.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Cauldron of Essence and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

413-1339-3394.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-1339-3394.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5670-6094--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-6094--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2021-2060-7267-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3115-3557-7487.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7768.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

4927-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4927-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4927-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2034-2048-4871-7147-7729.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {1}{U}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Repeat.

5078-6650-7729.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-7729.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat

4452-4529-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Bontu.
When God-Eternal Bontu dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Bontu's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Bontu.
As God-Eternal Bontu is a Lhurgoyf due to Rukarumel, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Bontu from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-5226-5445-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-5226-5445-7426.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing another artifact
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat

2525-3358-7296.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5795-7057-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Nightscape Familiar.
Repeat.

679-2894-5010-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-2894-5010-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Golgari Thug. Then, the draw will be replaced by Golgari Thug's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Golgari Thug from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

290-2341-2495.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Dreamstone Hedron and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Dreamstone Hedron and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Dreamstone Hedron and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

1849-3490-3755-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1849-3490-3755-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-567-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-567-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

141-1532-2292.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1532-2292.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-3817-5147.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-6311-6791.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

104-3197-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-4476.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2897-3372-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Gigantoplasm
2897-3372-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Gigantoplasm into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Gigantoplasm's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Gigantoplasm's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Gigantoplasm's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-4775-6553.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2511-4775-6553.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

673-813-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
673-813-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

575-897-2482-3875.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Branchsnap Lorian enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

1144-1262-3510.description:
Life and Limb and Yavimaya cause all lands to be 1/1 Saproling creatures that are also Forests in addition to their other types.
Because Drana and Linvala prevents your opponents from activating abilities of creatures they control, your opponents cannot activate abilities of lands or creatures they control.

1530-1948-4431.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is five or less.
An opponent cannot block and kill Zur.
1530-1948-4431.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tel-Jilad Stylus by tapping it, putting Second Chance on the bottom of your library from the battlefield.
Resolve the Second Chance trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare Zur as an attacker.
Zur triggers, searching your library for Second Chance and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1514-1673-2232-2459.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax (if applicable).
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chicken Troupe to your hand and returning any stickers on it to your sticker sheet.
Cast Chicken Troupe by paying {1}{G}.
Chicken Troupe enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chicken Troupe trigger, getting {TK} and putting an art sticker onto itself.
Goblin Airbrusher triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2635-3263-3716-3717.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness.
2635-3263-3716-3717.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying a total of at least {7}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, untapping Viridian Joiner and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing at least two damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
